Game Overview

In GunZone, the core idea is straightforward: dive into GunZone, an endless shooter where your skills as an ex-soldier are tested against relentless mini skeletons. Strategically choose from varied weapons, master smooth controls, and unleash special abilities to survive relentless waves. The ever-evolving battlefield ensures adrenaline-fueled excitement that keeps you on the edge.
